description: UrbanGround presents a Hong Kong urban simulation environment for embodied multimodal agents. The project describes a real-scale sandbox with Unity-based desktop or browser interaction. It supports experiments involving agent perception and movement in public space. The presented environment is a research artefact, and external validation or a continuing support commitment was not established. Published by UrbanGround research team. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Documentation is accessible through the linked paper or repository; executable access is limited to what that source states. Reuse licence: MIT for the repository; Hong Kong geospatial inputs have separate terms. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
